events.title: Safety Insurance: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
events.body: BOSTON (AP) : Safety Insurance Group Inc. SAFT) on Wednesday reported profit of $20.1 million in its fourth quarter. On a per-share basis, the Boston-based company said it had net income of $1.36.
